text:
Sasha: Quick async check — where are we on the Dedicated buildout milestones? I want a short status on procurement, racks, firmware, and the canary plan. Who's owning next steps?

Miguel: Procurement: PO-4892 submitted to vendor last Thurs. Vendor acknowledges, ETA to ship 10-12 business days. customs + transit might add 5-7 days. I flagged expedited but waiting on vendor confirmation.

Priya: Rack prep: power audit done for 4/6 datacenters. Remaining two scheduled next Tue. Need final breaker sizes from Miguel's vendor spec to confirm feed.

Jae: Firmware & images: got H100 image baseline ready. Still failing one thermal test on bench node (temp drift under sustained load). Debugging with hardware lab this afternoon. If that passes we can bake AMI/container image.

Anika: Monitoring / SRE: Can start wiring dashboards once Jae confirms image. Alerting runbook drafted here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/dedicated-capacity (please review). Also need a list of metric names for kv-cache and batch queue length.

Joel: Canary plan: propose 8-card canary pool (mix of q8b and q4 models) + traffic shadowing from 5% of internal test traffic for 48h, then 25% (prod-like) for 24h. Need sign-off on rollout window from PL and perf team.

Sasha: Ownership: Miguel for procurement/shipping; Priya for rack/site; Jae for image + perf; Anika for monitoring + runbook; Joel for canary plan + metrics. Can we confirm?

Miguel: Confirmed on procurement/shipping. FYI PO-4892 includes surge protection clause. Tracking number will be added to the sheet once vendor ships.

Priya: Confirmed for rack/site ownership. Blocking: vendor spec (Miguel) + 48h access windows from DC ops. I'll coordinate windows with ops team.

Jae: Confirmed for image/perf. ETA to finish thermal debug & image bake: end of day Friday if lab cooperates. If not, Monday.

Anika: Confirmed for monitoring. Two asks: (1) someone to add KV cache and batch queue metrics to the exporter (Miguel/Jae?), (2) short postmortem-style test checklist for canary failures. I can draft checklist but need the tech owners to fill expected thresholds.

Miguel: I can add exporter metrics for rack-level telemetry and power; Jae to add model/runtime metrics.

Joel: I'll assemble perf thresholds and a short checklist (p50/p95 latency, token throughput, error rate, memory reclaim events). Putting draft in PR later today.

Sasha: Nice. A few open risks: customs hold (procurement), thermal regression (image), DC access windows (rack). Let's prioritize mitigation owners in the PR: Miguel -> alternate vendor if shipping delayed; Jae -> fallback image with conservative clock/power settings; Priya -> negotiate weekend window.

infra-bot: Reminder: quota bump request for project redwood-dedicated still pending (ticket #3241). Cloud team estimated 3 business days to approve.

Miguel: I raised #3241 yesterday and pinged cloud-svcs. If quota takes >3 days we need to shift canary start. Considering local reserve of ephemeral capacity for smoke tests.

Priya: For scheduling: propose tentative canary start Wed 4/10 to allow image bake + dashboards. If procurement slips, we can run a software-only canary against a small reserved pool.

Sasha: OK. Action items: Miguel — confirm vendor ship date by EOD, update PO tracking sheet; Jae — finish thermal debug and attempt image bake, update PR with fallback image options; Joel — open PR with thresholds and canary checklist; Priya — confirm DC access windows and reserve weekend window; Anika — finalize runbook checklist template. I'll consolidate status tomorrow AM and adjust timeline. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
